en: Sparsh mode. Build a circuit by touch and sound.
One finger: swipe to move, tap to choose a part, then swipe to place it. Two fingers: tap to run, hold for a summary, swipe right to undo. Three finger tap any time for full help.
This is a 5 by 5 grid. You are at row 1, column 1. Three finger tap any time for help.
short circuit. Remove a wire and try again.
this circuit is not closed yet.
add a battery and a part before running.
To leave, swipe left twice with two fingers.

One finger: swipe to move. Tap once to repeat where you are. Double tap for wire. Triple tap for bulb. Four taps for resistor. Hold for battery. Tap, then hold, for switch. After choosing a part, swipe to place it; tap once to cancel. Two fingers: tap to run or stop. Hold for a summary. Swipe down to remove the part here. Swipe up to toggle a switch here. Swipe right to undo. Double tap for the guided lesson. Swipe left twice to leave. Three finger tap to hear this again.
Let's build your first circuit together. I'll guide you, one tap at a time. If you make a mistake, swipe right with two fingers to undo.
First, place a battery. Tap and hold anywhere, then swipe where it should go.
Now add a bulb. Triple tap, then swipe where it should go.
Now add another bulb. Triple tap, then swipe where it should go.
Now close the loop with a wire. Double tap, then swipe to place it.
Your circuit is ready. Two finger tap to run it and listen.
That's the hum of two bulbs in series. Two finger tap again when you're ready to rebuild it in parallel.
Now rebuild this in parallel. Two finger swipe down on a bulb to remove it, then use taps to add wires and a second bulb so two bulbs connect between the same two points.
Your parallel circuit is ready. Two finger tap to run it.
Listen. In parallel, both bulbs shine at full brightness, and the hum is louder.
You finished the guided lesson. Great work.
